description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) enhancement INSPIRATIONAL EXEMPLAR (Auric Champions, WP-C46): (once per battle round, per army) at the start of any phase, select one friendly battle-shocked ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit within 9" of this model: it is no longer battle-shocked. Fixture cus11e_c3_custodes_active (P1 Custodes active, Command phase); setup privileges: P1 detachment Auric Champions, the Shield-Captain given Inspirational Exemplar, Custodian Guard Beta (next to it) battle-shocked, CP 0 for both. The Movement phase starts (setup privilege: PhaseManager.transition_to_phase(7)): the start-of-phase window lists the free INSPIRATIONAL EXEMPLAR card; a real click on 'Use on Custodian Guard Sodality' lifts its battle-shock without CP.

steps.script:
GameState.state["factions"]["1"]["detachment"] = "Auric Champions"
GameState.state.players["1"]["cp"] = 0
GameState.state.players["2"]["cp"] = 0
GameState.state.units["U_SHIELD_CAPTAIN_A"].meta["enhancements"] = ["Inspirational Exemplar"]
GameState.state.units["U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_B"].flags["battle_shocked"] = true
PhaseManager.transition_to_phase(7)
return true
